title: Thirteen children in the family
summary: He was the eldest at home when his mother died in childbirth.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was going to say, how many were there in your family? How many brothers and sisters did you have?

Thirteen of us. Thirteen. Thirteen. I don't know. But I knew the last two. See, my mother died, well I was the largest one at home. The others died before my time, I didn't know them. See, I didn't know none of them. I only know six of us. Yeah. See, six years. But when my mother died, I was the largest one at home. All my two brothers had us gone. Then I had two sisters and a brother, younger than me. And my mother had twins after that, and they died babies, you see. My mother died in childbirth, she had a dropship. And she died for most two kids. So that was before that I didn't know nothing about it. But they were special. I played for each other.
